finalText:
**Repeats inside 5 minutes now drop.** Dedupe at [src/router.js:37](src/router.js:37).

`state.lastSent` is a `Map` from `key` to the `at` of the last delivery. Only a real delivery arms the window. A dropped repeat does not extend it. Window is `at - last < 5`, so a repeat at exactly 5 minutes still sends.

`node simulate.js` runs clean. 99 dropped, zero errors.

The dedupe covers every priority, `critical` included. `pager` fell from 225 to 200.

Next: say so if `critical` should skip dedupe.
